title: Scalable Multi-GPU Simulation of 3D Multicellular Growth with RNN-Based Workload Balancing
abstract: arXiv:2608.25890v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Detailed multicellular growth simulations based on subcellular element models (SEMs) can capture complex tissue development, but their element-level interactions impose substantial computational cost. This work presents a scalable multi-GPU framework for 3D multicellular growth simulation that combines GPU acceleration, spatial binning, domain decomposition, and workload-aware partitioning. Cell movement, growth, and division continuously reshape the spatial workload distribution, causing initially balanced partitions to become inefficient over time. To address this, we introduce an RNN-based load-balancing controller that observes recent per-rank execution times and partition states and learns residual corrections to a reactive boundary-adjustment rule. translated_title: 基于RNN工作负载平衡的可扩展多GPU三维多细胞生长模拟
translated_abstract: 基于亚细胞元素模型（SEMs）的详细多细胞生长模拟能够捕捉复杂的组织发育过程，但其元素级相互作用带来了巨大的计算成本。本研究提出了一个可扩展的多GPU三维多细胞生长模拟框架，该框架结合了GPU加速、空间分箱、域分解和工作负载感知分区。细胞运动、生长和分裂持续重塑空间工作负载分布，导致初始平衡的分区随时间推移变得低效。为解决这一问题，我们引入了一种基于RNN的负载平衡控制器，该控制器观察每个秩的最近执行时间和分区状态，并学习对反应性边界调整规则的残差修正。控制器在负载平衡循环的可微代理中离线训练，并带有随机化工作负载动态，训练无需实测执行轨迹。我们进行了评估...
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合RNN负载平衡控制器的多GPU三维多细胞生长模拟框架，通过离线训练实现自适应工作负载分配，显著提升计算可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-GPU 3D multicellular growth simulation framework with an RNN-based load-balancing controller, trained offline to adaptively distribute workloads, enhancing computational scalability.
